reuse.why: Builds shared getBudgetableCategories, hasSavedTemplates and getFixedGroupIds used by most actions, but matches the #fixed tag with a private regex instead of the shared/tags.ts helpers.

duplication.why: Removes the three copied category queries and the 6/12-month copies, but copyPreviousMonth still restates the selection rule (income, hidden, template, fixed checks) row by row, and the test file has two near-identical runAll/runAllHidden helpers.

placement.why: The selection and exclusion helpers live in budget/actions.ts beside the actions they serve; nothing leaks into other layers.

scope.why: Changes are limited to the month-wide actions, the new handler, tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: The shared selection is clear and parameterised, but because copyPreviousMonth applies the exclusions itself the rule has two definitions that must be kept in step.

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts copyPreviousMonth applies hidden/income/template/#fixed exclusions inline instead of using getBudgetableCategories (it only reuses hasSavedTemplates and getFixedGroupIds).

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth's chain of early returns over getBudgetData rows reshapes getBudgetableCategories' SQL+filter into per-row checks rather than sharing it.

abstraction_drift.where: getBudgetableCategories gained includeHiddenCategories (interpolated into its SQL) in step 4; copyPreviousMonth bypasses it, and getBudgetData was widened with goal_def/cat_group to support that bypass.
